headline: Impairment charges swing GAAP loss; adjusted profit grows
summary_short: General Mills' fiscal Q4 net sales rose 1% y/y to $4.61B, but GAAP results swung to a $2.01B net loss (EPS -$3.74 vs. $0.53 a year ago) on $1.75B of impairment charges plus a $1.03B Brazil valuation loss; adjusted diluted EPS still rose 27% (cc) to $0.95.
summary_long: Fiscal Q4 (year ended May 31, 2026, a 53-week year) net sales rose 1% to $4.61B; organic net sales were flat. GAAP operating loss of $2.09B and net loss of $2.01B (diluted EPS -$3.74) reflect a $1.75B goodwill/intangible impairment (mainly North America Pet) plus a $1.03B Brazil-divestiture valuation loss. Adjusted diluted EPS rose 27% (cc) to $0.95 on adjusted operating profit +13% (cc) to $705M and gross margin +240bps to 34.8%. Cash rose to $454M from $364M; FY capex $540M, buybacks $500M. Dividend held at $0.61/share. FY2027 guidance (initiated): organic net sales -1.5% to +0.5%; adjusted operating profit -13% to -8% (cc); adjusted diluted EPS $3.00-$3.20; targeting $3B cost savings by FY2030, $750M+ in FY2027.

drivers.explanation: Growth included a 7-point benefit from the 53rd week and 1-point FX benefit, offset by a 7-point headwind from divestitures and acquisitions; organic net sales were flat.
Swing to a loss was driven primarily by lower operating profit, reflecting the goodwill/intangible impairment and Brazil valuation loss.
Higher adjusted operating profit, a lower adjusted effective tax rate, and lower net shares outstanding, partly offset by higher net interest expense.

$1.75B non-cash goodwill/brand-intangible impairment (North America Pet reporting unit and Nudges/True Chews brands, driven by higher discount rates) plus a $1.03B non-cash valuation loss on the planned Brazil divestiture.
Higher adjusted gross profit dollars, including a 7-point benefit from favorable trade expense timing.
Favorable net price realization and mix and favorable mark-to-market effects, partially offset by higher input costs.
Same non-cash impairment and Brazil valuation-loss charges that drove the GAAP operating loss, compounded by a 102.2% effective tax rate since the goodwill charge was non-deductible.
Not explained item-by-item in the release; consistent with $2.2B of full-year operating cash flow and $1.83B of divestiture proceeds against $540M of capex, $500M of buybacks, and $1.3B of dividends.
CEO Jeff Harmening called Q4 adjusted results in line with expectations and outlined a shift toward brand remarkability and a $3B cost-savings target by fiscal 2030 to restore organic growth.
